headline: Claude's reasoning tokens reshape AI cost economics for healthcare developers
body: Claude's extended reasoning capability is generating developer interest around token efficiency and cost optimization, with multiple projects testing whether increased per-step reasoning effort reduces overall API costs. For healthcare AI implementations, this directly impacts the economics of clinical decision support and documentation automation tools that rely on API-based LLMs. The ability to trade computational reasoning for fewer total tokens could reduce infrastructure costs for EHR integrations and real-time clinical workflow tools that currently face margin pressure. Healthcare vendors and consulting teams evaluating Claude for production workloads should benchmark these reasoning-token tradeoffs against their specific use case token volumes and latency requirements.
